notes: Added missing schema, core logic, and facade/API stories to meet minimum and complete flow.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for clinical trial snapshot
Added core logic extraction and normalization story

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S1.title: Define Clinical Trial Snapshot Schema and Contract
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S1.description: Define a consistent schema for clinical trial snapshot including phase, status, summary, eligibility, locations, and URL. Ensure alignment between domain service output, facade response, and frontend rendering expectations.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S2.title: Implement Clinical Trial Extraction and Normalization Logic
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S2.description: Implement logic in clinical_trials_service to extract raw ClinicalTrials.gov fields and normalize into the snapshot schema, including handling missing fields, formatting eligibility text, consolidating locations, and ensuring clean summary output.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S3.title: Expose Clinical Trial Snapshot via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S3.description: Integrate normalized clinical trial snapshot into evaluate_care_facade so it can be returned through the tool router and surfaced to the chat UI, ensuring compatibility with existing orchestration and tool-use flow.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S4.title: Frontend Rendering of Clinical Trial Snapshot with Safe Links
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S4.description: Render clinical trial snapshot data in chat UI using structured formatting (phase, status, summary, eligibility, locations, URL) and ensure URLs are safely rendered and validated via existing markdown rendering and backend URL guardian safeguards.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trial Snapshot Flow
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S5.description: Create unit tests for extraction and normalization logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov API response through service, facade, and frontend rendering layers, including edge cases for missing fields, malformed data, and invalid or unsafe URLs.
